delete.description: Deletes an account group. A group can only be deleted once it is empty: remove, move or delete its accounts first (see Remove Account from Group) and move or delete its sub-groups. Accounts are never reassigned automatically.

204.description: No Content — the group was deleted.

400.description:
Bad Request. The `code` field tells the reason:

- `GROUP_HAS_ACCOUNTS` — the group still has accounts. Remove them from the group first.
- `GROUP_HAS_SUBGROUPS` — the group still has sub-groups. Move them to another parent (or detach them with Update Account Group) or delete them first.

messages: Cannot delete account group that still has sub-groups

404.description: Not Found — no account group with that `account_group_id` in this organization.
